title: Chapter 561
paragraphs: Chapter 561
Episode 147. The King of the Black Sea, Gliek (5)
They use the power of the Demon God Stone to make Ron fight again.
The situation was so urgent and dangerous that Star hadn't honestly thought that far.
It wasn't easy to make a decision to use someone who was an enemy just a while ago, especially the leader of the Gipil, in this way, even when they could think calmly.
Jin's hand clutching the sword was visibly trembling.
It wasn't trembling out of fear or a counter-reaction. It was trembling because he had to directly face the grim reality of having no other choice.
What is the Demon God Stone?
Until Gliek woke up, the Hairan and Vamel Alliance risked their lives protecting the Sword Emperor's Castle with it, with Ron and Jin at the center.
And now, Jin said he would use that object to save Ron and make him fight again.
No one could gauge what kind of feelings he had when he made the decision that he would have least wanted to make.
'I've made a big mistake to the 12th graduate.'
He was embarrassed. Also, Star had the opportunity to reconsider why Chiron had been so interested in Jin.
Zheung-!
Star and the Black Knights fend off the swords and spears that are being thrust at Jin.
"I will surely take responsibility for the disrespect I just showed, 12th graduate."
Jin was madly running between hundreds of falling swords and spears while carrying Ron.
'We can't end like this, Sir Ron!'
The mumbling voice of Ron coming from his back was louder and heavier than any roar on the battlefield.
My grandson is in there.
Those faint words, like a milestone, were pounding in Jin's heart.
It was certain that some of Dante's consciousness remained. The hesitation of his sword just before he and Ron were about to be hit couldn't be explained otherwise.
But if only part of Dante's consciousness remains.
What happens after killing Gliek? When he's done, will the remaining consciousness of Dante completely disappear?
Can Dante return?
There was no time to have such questions. Tess's flame had disappeared, Ron was incapacitated, and the Black Sea transformation was underway.
Gliek's attacks were increasingly pressing the party.
The only relief was that Gliek's attention was still focused on Jin and the rear.
The Talaris and Vamel Alliance were in a situation where they couldn't do anything, so they barely suffered any attacks from Gliek.
Gradually, they could feel the heat. It meant that Kelriac's flames were breaking through the chaos and approaching Gliek.

He was desperately pushing back the chaos and approaching Jin. The situation inside was not visible from the outside, and even Tess's Blue Flame Horse had disappeared, so they were burning with anxiety.
Gliek's twisted limbs were finding their places.
As a result, his sword and spear became sharper, and Star and the Black Knights' defenses were reaching their limits.
Puff-!
An explosion of chaotic energy erupted from behind Jin's back. Though he desperately used a spell, it was impossible to completely avoid the shock that affected Ron on his back.
The Rashid that Ron had been holding until then rolled on the ground with a clatter.
Going in to retrieve the sword was as good as committing suicide.
Just as they were about to rush towards the heat of Kelriac,
"Have you even lost your sword now, you foolish human?"
Suddenly, a chilling cold enveloped Jin and Ron, making them come to their senses.
Endorma, the ruler of Talaris, had finally recovered and rejoined the battlefield. Her eyes were filled with moisture as she looked at Ron, who had become a full-fledged spearman.
[There was a human chosen by the Ice…]
Gliek looked down at Talaris.
Having drawn on some of the power that sealed Elona Gipil, she exuded an energy that was completely different from before.
However, she couldn't maintain that power for long. She had already been injured while using the Five Elements Array, and waking up Elona Gipil in this situation would be unbearable.
The attack stopped for a moment. Gliek had started to clearly recognize Talaris.
Star and the Black Knights caught their breath, and Talaris picked up Rashid and approached Jin and Ron.
She was thinking the same as Jin.
"Your beloved grandson is still fighting alone with that bastard. Ron, it's not time for you to stop yet..."
Talaris determined that Dante hadn't completely disappeared yet.
If the seal restraining Gliek had completely broken, not only her but everyone near the inner city would have never survived.
[You're persistent.]
Gliek's remark wasn't only for Ron. It was also for Dante, who was still preventing his complete revival.
Chi-ing...
The Ice was resonating and spreading cold energy all around.
The ground froze from that energy, noticeably slowing down the Black Sea transformation, but Gliek realized something.
That Jin was not a Solderet, but a contractor under the protection of the shadow.
That didn't mean his killing intent had weakened. Rather, Gliek would now fight more cautiously and leisurely from this point on.
If the opponent is not a Solderet but a Contractor, there is no need to be afraid and impatient.
Gliek, not being fully rational, had been afraid of Jin even when he thought the Solderet had lost his power.
Gliek bared his sharp teeth in laughter. Then, as if playing a prank, he thrust his sword and spear towards Jin's comrades.
His attack was blocked by a massive ice wall formed by Talaris before it could reach the Vamel Alliance, and Gliek continued to strike down on it, laughing as if it was amusing.
[Hahaha…!]
Every time Gliek laughed, the chaotic energy that filled the battlefield surged ominously.
Talaris knew well where his leisure stemmed from.
The power to defy fate.
There is a record in the abyss that only those who have reached the realm of creation can defeat the King of Chaos.
No matter how deep and vast the power, only the sword and magic of creation can inflict fundamental damage to the kings of the Black Sea.
That is why the lords of Hairan have never been able to cut the white stone.
There has never been a Creation Knight in Hairan.

If the information about the white stone hadn't disappeared at some point in history like being swept away by the current, Hairan would have handed the white stone to the humans who reached the creation of Runcandel and Zipfel.
However, there is no meaning to assumptions in a history that has already happened, and it is already determined that Gliek will awaken in this land today.
It was fate.
"Jin."
"Yes, Talaris."
"What we have to do is hold him back until your father arrives."
Or else, I can only hope that the records I know are wrong.
Talaris swallowed her words and handed Rashid to Ron's sagging right hand.
Even though he had lost all sensation, Ron didn't let go of the hilt of the sword that he had touched again.
She didn't attach much importance to the fact that Dante's consciousness still remained in Gliek.
Since he couldn't have the power to defy fate, extinction was inevitable.
Until Chiron arrives.
The strongest humans, excluding Chiron, are gathered, and the elites of Runcandel and Zipfel are almost all here. The fact that this was all they could do was nothing but disappointing.
The energy of the ice was blocking the blackening, but it didn't stop. As the ground turned black, his size grew larger and larger.
An indescribable sinister purple swirled in the empty eye sockets. Just facing those pupils caused a ringing in the ears, accompanied by an intense headache.
Kiiaaaak!
As Gliek became more complete, the stone of extinction expressed its fear even more intensely.
And finally, Kelliark Zipfel broke through the wall of chaos and entered inside. The first thing they saw as the rear opened was the rapidly descending forefront of Cozak, as if crashing down.
Kuong, Krgk…!
Cozak landed, scraping the blackened ground. Kelliark, who had spread a magic circle at the forefront, bulged his bloodshot eyes and looked around.
He was looking for Jin. As soon as he realized that Jin had survived, the breath he had been holding unknowingly burst out.
'He's alive!'
A fireball as big as the sun was rising behind Kelliark.
[Are you the owner of that grotesque imitation.]
"Kelliark!"
Talaris shouted.
Kelliark was the same as Talaris. He, too, had intended to resurrect Ron with the power of the stone of extinction if she had already died or was incapable of fighting, and make her fight again.
However, the unique black energy that appears when the energy of the stone of extinction is mixed in Kelliark's fireball was hardly visible.
That was the problem. The stone of extinction was still not properly giving power to Kelliark. That power seemed to be condensed and hidden in Kelliark's staff, Huroti.
The power of the stone of extinction condensed in Huroti was not being released.
Jin, Talaris, and the Black Knights couldn't help but sense something was wrong from that sight.
The most confused was Kelliark himself. He knew that the stone of extinction had shrunk, but he didn't know it would be this much.
'It's impossible like this!'
The stone of extinction is incomplete. The power of the gods trapped inside was not yet fully under Kelliark's control.
Defeat.
Kelliark and Talaris simultaneously thought of the same word.
'If Ron can't fight again, we don't know how long we can hold against him, even if Runcandel arrives.'
'Are you saying that even the will of more than thirty gods can't defy the King of the Black Sea!'
But then, suddenly, Ron started walking towards Kelliark from Jin's back. The mumbling had stopped.
He was dead.
Ron was walking, lifeless. As if time had stopped for a moment, everyone froze and watched Ron approach Kelliark. Rashid was still in Ron's hand.
Somehow, as Ron got closer to Kelliark, the screams filled with fear from the stone of extinction were diminishing.
'The stone of extinction... it's responding to Ron who's dead, not me...!'
Ron knelt in front of the black energy of Huroti with her sword stuck in the ground, as if praying.
Then, the stone of extinction fell silent, and Kelliark could feel it.
He could feel that the scared gods were giving him power.
